name: @stimmig/api-types
description: TypeScript types generated from the pipeline's OpenAPI schema. Do not edit src/pipeline.ts by hand.

scripts.gen: cd ../../services/pipeline && uv run stimmig-pipeline openapi --out ../../packages/api-types/openapi.json && cd ../../packages/api-types && openapi-typescript openapi.json -o src/pipeline.ts
scripts.check:drift: npm run gen && git diff --exit-code -- openapi.json src/pipeline.ts
